title: Create contact
$sideEffectsComment: HubSpot has no idempotency header, so a retry creates a SECOND contact. It de-duplicates on email at the account level, which softens the common case and does nothing for a contact created without one -- so this is declared unsafe rather than idempotent, and a host must not replay it blindly.

constants.$comment: Required by HubSpot's own schema (SimplePublicObjectInputForCreate lists both `associations` and `properties` as required) and always empty for a plain create. A constant rather than a config field: an author has nothing to decide here, and a field with one legal value is a field that only invites a wrong answer.

config.label: Email
config.description: HubSpot de-duplicates contacts on email within an account. A contact created without one cannot be de-duplicated, and a retry will make a second.

config.label: Lifecycle stage
config.description: HubSpot's own stage names. A value it does not recognise is refused at write time, not at setup.
